title: General William Booth Enters into Heaven, and Other Poems
sourceTitle: General William Booth Enters into Heaven, and Other Poems
author: Vachel Lindsay
description: "General William Booth Enters into Heaven, and Other Poems" by Vachel Lindsay is a collection of poetry that reflects the author's artistic vision and socio-political commentary, written in the early 20th century.
longDescription: This book captures themes of spirituality, social justice, and the intersection of beauty and suffering, articulated through a vibrant, rhythmic style that seeks to restore the oral tradition in poetry. Lindsay's work serves as a critique of society while also advocating for beauty and compassion, often channeling his thoughts through historical and literary figures.

authorInfo.bio: Nicholas Vachel Lindsay was an American poet. He is considered a founder of modern singing poetry, as he referred to it, in which verses are meant to be sung or chanted.
